levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: Ali bin Yaqtin narrates the story (قال استدعى الرشيد), and the Imam Musa speaks inside it, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5).
Harun al-Rashid speaks in the story but is addressed, not a transmitter of the saying; he is not a link.
أخيه الحسين and أبيه علي بن يقطين are read as name-only links (rule 7).
